author: Vinicia Pell, Imperial Antiquarian

#The Ayleids

Before the Empire, before even the Nords came south, Cyrodiil belonged to the Ayleids, the wild elves, who built white towers and worshipped the light of the stars.

Their ruins are everywhere in the Heartlands, half sunk in the earth. Most are empty. The ones that are not, should be left alone.

#Welkynd Stones

In every ruin you will find stones of blue glass that glow without fire. The Ayleids called them welkynd: sky-stuff. They hold the light of Aetherius itself.

A welkynd stone can restore a mage's strength, once. After that it is only pretty. Collectors pay well regardless.

#A Warning

The Ayleids did not like to be robbed even when they were alive. Their ruins are guarded by things that do not need to breathe.

If you go, go in daylight, go with friends, and take only what is lying on the floor.
